handlers.name: ActorVM_DestroyOrClearActor
handlers.mode_field: The command payload byte at A2+0x01 selects the ordinary versus linked cleanup path.

ordinary_path.condition: A2+0x01 == 0 and current actor flags +0x3C bit 0x04 is clear
writes: release current actor resources through Actor_ClearOwnedResources
when +0x3E links another actor, clear the linked actor's +0x3E link and clear its +0x3C bit 0x04
ordinary_path.linked_record: The linked actor remains typed and resource-owned on this ordinary path; only its link and bit 0x04 are released.

full_cleanup_path.condition: A2+0x01 != 0 or current actor flags +0x3C bit 0x04 is set
writes: clear current actor type and owned resources
when +0x3E links another actor, clear the linked actor type and owned resources

handlers.lifecycle_boundary: This handler can retire an actor record. It is distinct from EC/82, whose selected cursor write only clears animation_pc or movement_pc while leaving the actor type and frame/resource state live.

handlers.name: ActorVM_FaceTowardPlayer
writes: set actor +0x09 to 0xFF when PLAYER_WORLD_X is less than actor X at +0x02
handlers.result: The actor faces right/normal when the player is at or to the right of its X coordinate and faces left/flipped when the player is left of it.

shared_helpers.0x001ABE6E: Actor_ClearAndRelease clears the current type/resources and then clears the linked actor type/resources when +0x3E is nonzero.
shared_helpers.0x001AE372: Actor_ClearOwnedResources releases the actor-owned resource list selected by +0x29 and clears its resource pointers.

evidence: ActorVM dispatch table mapping F6/8C and F7/8D
Existing EC/82 cursor-clear finding and actor record lifecycle contract
conclusion: The actor VM lifecycle boundary is explicit: EC/82 is cursor-only, while F6/8C chooses a link-preserving retirement path or full current-and-linked cleanup from the command mode and actor flag bit. F7/8D deterministically derives the actor horizontal-facing byte from PLAYER_WORLD_X versus actor X.
